bio: This charmingly laid-back restaurant serves dishes made with regional and seasonal ingredients, drawing on influences from the Mediterranean and beyond. The best way to experience the culinary artistry is through the six-course set menu. There is also a popular lunch deal that changes weekly. In the summer, the terrace on the charming little market square beckons, whether for a meal, a glass of wine or a coffee. The service is friendly and attentive. Across the street is the Marktkeller brasserie and wine bar. They also put on regular themed evenings. Tip: Take a stroll through the enchanting little half-timbered town!...
